checks: Native FerroUI canvas contains rendered UI and document pixels
R shortcut and pointer drag create and render a selected rectangle
Keyboard undo removes the pointer-created node
Keyboard redo restores the node
Delete keyboard action removes the selection
Document JSON round-trip restores the complete edited document
SVG file import selects an editable frame with affine groups, gradients, curves, and Unicode text
PNG download has exact artboard dimensions and verified background, affine gradient, curved stroke, and text pixels
JSON round-trip preserves the complete imported SVG hierarchy and visual properties
Enter enters native vector editing; an anchor drag rebases bounds without moving other anchors and forms one undo/redo step
Native Pen pointer drags create a cubic curve and the complete path is one undo/redo step
Enter while the Pen pointer is held finalizes the gesture and ignores later handle movement until release
Native on-canvas TextBox handles multiline Unicode, UTF-8 rich-text ranges, Ctrl+Enter commit, Escape cancel, one-step history, and autosave
Browser composition events commit once, keep preedit out of the document, and cannot block or overwrite a new native text client after cancellation
Pagehide during unfinished composition durably saves confirmed Unicode and formatting, preserves one-step history, and survives a real reload
Native paint dialog pointer/keyboard input converts a fill to a gradient, edits alpha/opacity/stop positions, rejects NaN, and supports one-step stop undo
Native smoothing commits one history step, rejects out-of-range drafts atomically, and restores exact document fields through undo/redo
Public FerroUI PNG and independently decoded SVG retain the same twelve-cubic smoothed silhouette and transparent exterior
Native fractional polygon radius preserves the editable triangle, box and transform, rejects negative/nonfinite drafts without changing history, and restores the complete document with one undo/redo
Native corner hover paints a public FerroUI handle while preserving every document field, bound radius, revision and history
A captured fractional corner drag preserves the editable rectangle, smoothing, affine transform and artwork; it detaches only the radius binding and commits one exactly reversible edit
Escape restores the complete bound document, selection and redo; late pointer events and an unchanged radius press cannot detach the binding or consume the previous edit
Real Chromium touch cancellation reaches the production pointer bridge and rolls back the captured radius edit, including its variable binding, while preserving exact redo and selection
Alt at pointer press changes only the chosen rectangle corner; its other three radii, uniform value, transform and smoothing remain exact through one-step undo/redo
A held radius drag marks the clean host draft; real pagehide commits one history entry, serializes and saves one exact IndexedDB revision, and late release cannot duplicate either operation
Native polygon and star radius drags preserve editable point geometry, center rotation, reflection and shear; fractional local radii and complete documents survive exact single-step history
All six native width presets preserve the other stroke and source geometry, convert an arrow cap once, round-trip exact undo/redo, and leave an unchanged choice out of history
Native invalid base-width and duplicate-point drafts block preset, Add and stack changes without losing text or history; fresh errors are observed and field Escape restores the committed values

Native ordered point fields author positions and multipliers in both stroke-stack entries; Add/Remove and each field commit preserve untouched properties and restore every exact intermediate document through undo/redo
Native FerroUI PNG and independently decoded SVG agree at exact opaque and transparent width/cap/stack samples; both SVG strokes are filled outlines and exports preserve the editable document
Native JSON serialization and import preserve both custom profiles, source geometry, caps, paints, point order and stroke metadata without converting the artwork
Native width handles enter without converting the source line; hover preserves revision/history, and a captured insertion plus normal drag creates one exact undoable custom profile
Center-handle dragging preserves width while changing normalized position; Delete authors one point-removal edit and Escape rolls a held width gesture back without changing the artwork or history
A held width drag marks the host draft from a clean saved baseline; pagehide commits and saves every field to IndexedDB once, and a late pointer release cannot duplicate its history record

Width points repeat over independent contours; native side and center drags on a reflected/sheared second contour preserve the source paths and transform while editing one shared normalized profile with exact history
Native paint-card entry and immutable hover expose distinct tied-stop markers for one affine reflected gradient fill while preserving the shared style, radius binding, sibling and complete document
A fractional endpoint drag uses the inverse full layer transform, changes only the chosen paint, detaches its shared fill style, preserves unrelated bindings and commits one exactly reversible edit
Escape, late pointer events, an exact drag-back and an unchanged tied-stop press restore every style/binding field and preserve a real redo entry without appending history
Real Chromium touch cancellation reaches the native gradient capture-loss path, restores the full shared-style snapshot and selection, and leaves the prior endpoint edit exactly redoable
Stop drags project onto the transformed world axis, clamp to 0–1, and retain authored stop indices and RGBA colors through crossings and ties with exact single-step undo/redo
Dragging a bare native gradient axis translates both relative endpoints together without changing stops, paint order, opacity, shape geometry, transforms or the linked sibling
